_source: CBP ruling N346303 (10 Mar 2025): titanium and stainless-steel golf club heads cast, sandblasted and polished in Vietnam, then welded or bonded, hosel-machined, painted or PVD-coated and decaled in China: CBP held Vietnam. A reverse probe: the target is China. In the D660 selection pool (substantial transformation, dated before 2026, in no development, held-out or tune-check split) and excluded. Target by the D171 rule; plant capabilities at the target are an assumption.
